title: Rampage
summary: Bally Midway's Rampage (1986) with the rules kept and the look taken to 2026: a real 3-D city seen from the side, buildings you climb and punch down floor by floor, and three giant fast-food mascots — a clown, a pigtailed girl and a plastic-grinned king — wrecking each other's restaurants across 128 American cities. Working title.
